title: The underworld in the Kalmyk epic Jangar

tellings.quote: And in the Jungre epic, the underworld is described. How creatures live there, how they communicate, how they come to the surface.

plain: The Jangar, the old heroic epic of the Kalmyk people of southern Russia, describes an underworld: according to the president of a Russian republic who tells Michels he was taken by aliens in 1997, the epic tells "how creatures live there, how they communicate, how they come to the surface." That is his reading of the epic, and he offers it as an old memory of beings living beneath the earth. He does not quote the verses, so which parts of the epic he means is left open.
